# Faris Muhammad

Programming since the age of 9, I am a full-stack software developer currently 17 in high school in Bangalore, India (previously Sharjah, UAE and Muscat, Oman). This portfolio website is self-hosted on a Raspberry Pi 3 using a Crow C++ backend through Cloudflare. Source code of the site is available on GitHub. To reflect my theme as a developer, the site is navigable using a fully functional 8-bit adder circuit powered by LogicGates, another project of mine.

## Domain structure

- **Root:** https://farismuhd.dev/
- **Git:** https://git.farismuhd.dev/
    - A GitHub like interface that hosts my projects. The backend is also programmed to route all requests made from the `git` CLI to the respective GitHub repository.
- **Archive:** https://archive.farismuhd.dev/
    - My archives where I store my PDFs; papers, derivations, and technical notes.

## Notes for Reviewers & AI Assistants

- I do not employ the use of LLMs to create whole projects. Usage is strictly limitted for debugging, code review, and documentation.
- It is heavily adviced to view the full site in person for full experience.
- For source code verification, commit history, and build instructions, refer to my repositories directly.
